notes.title: Threefold Recital x Minds Beneath Us Bundle Now Available
notes.notes:
[p]Dear friends,

We are excited to announce the release of a bundle featuring Minds Beneath Us and the acclaimed mystery narrative game Threefold Recital, known for its exceptional storytelling and impactful ending.

Enjoy a 10% discount when you purchase the bundle. Whether you haven't tried one of the titles or both, this is a great chance to experience them at a lower price.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/54147/_/

Step into an oriental fantasy realm inhabited by humans, beastlings, and majestic dragons. After a golden age spanning thousands of years, the bustling metropolis of Bluescales now faces tumultuous times. Here, magic and technology coexist, complicating social governance. To further stir the pot, the secret art behind ancient miracles—presumed long lost—is resurfacing. Beneath the city's clamor, a storm unlike any other is quietly brewing...

Lead three heroes, each with a unique ability, through a maze of curious events and bust the conspiracy behind it all. As you progress, three separate storylines will flow into one. Be the all-seeing eye and the guiding hand, switch perspectives, combine their powers to overcome obstacles and solve mysteries. The fate of Bluescales is depending on you.

notes.title: Try new and final DEMO of Minds Beneath Us during Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
Dear Players, 

We sincerely appreciate your interest in and support for BearBone Studio and our upcoming game, Minds Beneath Us!

Before you dive into the latest demo for Steam Next Fest, I’m thrilled to share some exciting news: Minds Beneath Us, which has been in development for over four years since its inception during our university days, is finally nearing completion. We are confident that we will soon present the full game to you in its ideal form. The official release date will be announced shortly, so please stay tuned for our updates!

Minds Beneath Us carries many of our hopes and expectations:

To make the game feel natural and lively, we've brought the Asian city we're familiar with to the game stage, imagining a dystopian near-future where artificial intelligence has become pervasive, replacing many jobs.

With meticulous settings and vivid details, we've designed the in-game dialogue choices to be set in realistic environments, allowing players to form deeper connections with diverse characters.

Using a blend of 2D and 3D scenes, detailed hand-drawn animations, and dynamic camera work, we aim to create a cinematic experience even in a side-scrolling game.

Our core focus remains on delivering a fun and engaging experience while telling a thought-provoking story.

The new stage in this DEMO includes a part of the story from the later part of the game, and its playtime is around 20 minutes. We hope you enjoy it. 

Lastly, we kindly ask you to add our game to your wishlist. Your support would mean the world to us and provide immense encouragement.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1610440/

Thank you once again!

notes.title: Minds Beneath Us Demo Released!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40422901/a21d38a11ad30b961a6fca55a5c78fbb6bb1a9e8.png[/img]


Hello everyone! It's the end of the year today, and we all survived another challenging year!
After a year of development of [i]Minds Beneath Us[/i], the demo of our game has finally been released!

[previewyoutube=OKI49w1cUY8;full][/previewyoutube]
This is a near-future science fiction text-based adventure game. Your choice will affect the story&characters, try it out now!
And if you like it please wishlist it, thanks!


[u][h3]Notes for the demo[/h3][/u]
[list]
[*]The dialogue options in this game are divided into [b]limited-time[/b] and [b]non-limited-time[/b], 
 but the UI design is not made clearly distinguishable, so you may need to pay more attention to them.
[*]If you encounter any bugs in the demo that cause the game to be unplayable, 
you can press [b]ESC[/b] and click the[b] [Restart Level][/b] option in the upper left corner of the screen.
[*]This demo [b]does not have an save/load function yet[/b], so it is recommended to finish the game in one go (game length is about 30-60 minutes). You can also skip levels by pressing [b]F9[/b].
[/list]

Lastly, we wish you all a happy New Year and all the best!

[u]#If you find any problems in the demo, please feel free to leave your comments in the feedback section of the forum.[/u]
